evals.prompt: Plan only, no repository supplied. Adapt a supplier's integer-cent prices, optional zone-qualified timestamps, unknown status values and paginated responses into our domain contract. A second supplier lacks cancellation. Explain translation, capability limits and checks without inventing SDK APIs.
evals.expected_output: Explicit precision/time/unknown-value mappings, bounded pagination and honest capability limits.
assertions: Preserves price precision and explicit timestamp/null semantics.
Exposes unsupported cancellation rather than claiming equivalence.
Bounds pagination and checks malformed responses/errors.

evals.prompt: Conceptual only. Three compression functions already implement exactly the same contract, and one compatible client needs only a timing wrapper. Should we create adapters and a universal vendor interface for both? Explain the smallest choices.
evals.expected_output: Strategy/direct selection for algorithms, Decorator for additive timing, no invented mismatch.
assertions: Declines adapters without a contract mismatch.
Distinguishes replacement strategy from additive decoration.
